newsitem.title: USA: Carter-Wallace names Levine president, COO.
newsitem.headline: Carter-Wallace names Levine president, COO.

text.p: Carter-Wallace Inc said on Friday its board had named Ralph Levine president and chief operating officer, effective April 1, 1997, succeeding Daniel Black, who is retiring.
Levine, 60, currentl;y is vice president, secretary and general counsel for Carter-Wallace. He had been with the company for 34 years.
Paul Veteri will become executive vice president and chief financial officer effective April 1, the company said.
Veteri, 54, is now vice president-finance and chief financial officer.
Carter-Wallace markets toiletries, proprietary drugs and pet products.
